thread:
Alex G: Heads up — opened PR #4823 that touches the batcher + attention-tiling path. Needs a quick perf smoke and KV collision sanity check before I can merge into canary.
Maria L: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4823 — tl;dr: reduce tile stride and tweak prefetch gating; expected p50 improvement, watch for batching shifts.
Samir P: I can run the perf jobs. What command should I use for the smoke?
Alex G: Run `./infra/scripts/run_perf_smoke.sh --pr 4823 --samples 100` — check `latency_p50` and `batch_fill_rate` in the artifacts. Also watch `kv_miss_rate` for any spike.
Jess: FYI I hit a flaky `kvcache/ttl_test` locally; pushed a tiny fix to the branch (should be non-functional change). PTAL @Samir P for perf and @Maria L for correctness.
Samir P: Starting smoke now. If perf looks good I'll approve. ETA ~12m.
deploy-bot: Canary merge window opens in 1 hour (03:00 UTC). Reminder: merges into canary require 2 approvals and no perf regressions on gated tests.
Maria L: Quick skim — logic change looks fine for long-context usage. Left one tiny inline nit about a comment. No correctness blockers from me; will give final LGTM after perf.
Samir P: Smoke finished: `latency_p50` -2.1%, `batch_fill_rate` stable, `kv_miss_rate` +0.3% (within noise). Artifacts uploaded: http://ci.internal/artifacts/4823 (perf + traces).
Alex G: Great, thanks. @Jess can you verify the unit test flakiness is resolved on CI? If so I'll queue the merge for the canary window.
Jess: Re-ran `kvcache/ttl_test` x20 on CI, all green. Addressed my comment inline, approving now.
Alex G: Thanks everyone — merging in ~45m into canary :rocket: Will monitor canary for 2 hours and promote if stable.
